What time is it now?
It's 8:10 now.
What time do you have class?

items.py: Wǒ shàngwǔ bā diǎn shàng kè.
items.en: I have class at 8am.

items.py: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
items.en: What time do you get up every day?
What do you do in the afternoon?
David: Excuse me, what time is it?

items.py: Wáng Lán: Xiànzài bā diǎn shí fēn.
items.en: Wang Lan: It's 8:10.

items.py: Dàwèi: Xièxie. Nǐ jǐ diǎn shàng kè?
items.en: David: Thanks. What time do you have class?

items.zh: 王兰：我上午八点半上课。你呢？
items.py: Wáng Lán: Wǒ shàngwǔ bā diǎn bàn shàng kè. Nǐ ne?
items.en: Wang Lan: I have class at 8:30am. And you?

items.zh: 大卫：我八点一刻上课。我走了。再见！
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ bā diǎn yí kè shàng kè. Wǒ zǒu le. Zàijiàn!
items.en: David: I have class at 8:15. I'm off. Bye!
Wang Lan: Goodbye!

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
items.en: Mary: What time do you get up every day?

items.zh: 和子：我每天六点半起床。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng.
items.en: Kazuko: I get up at 6:30 every day.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ jǐ diǎn chī zǎofàn?
items.en: Mary: What time do you eat breakfast?
Kazuko: 7 o'clock. And you?

items.zh: 玛丽：我七点半吃早饭。下午你做什么？
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ qī diǎn bàn chī zǎofàn. Xiàwǔ nǐ zuò shénme?
items.en: Mary: I eat breakfast at 7:30. What do you do in the afternoon?

items.zh: 和子：下午我去图书馆。你下午做什么？
items.py: Hézǐ: Xiàwǔ wǒ qù túshūguǎn. Nǐ xiàwǔ zuò shénme?
items.en: Kazuko: In the afternoon I go to the library. What do you do in the afternoon?

items.zh: 玛丽：我下午两点上课，四点下课。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn shàng kè, sì diǎn xià kè.
items.en: Mary: I have class at 2pm and finish at 4pm.

items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ wǎnshang jǐ diǎn shuì jiào?
items.en: Kazuko: What time do you go to bed at night?
Mary: 11 o'clock.
What time is it? (几点 asks the hour)
What time do you have class? (time before verb)
I have class at 8. (time word as adverbial)
He studies Chinese in the morning. (time of day before verb)

items.py: Wǒ měi tiān qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
items.en: I get up at 7 every day. (每天 = every day, before time)

items.py: Tā měi tiān xiàwǔ qù túshūguǎn.
items.en: She goes to the library every afternoon. (每天 + time of day)

items.zh: 主语 + 时间 + 动词
items.en: Word order: Subject + Time + Verb

items.py: Wǒ xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn shàng kè.
items.en: I have class at 2pm. (large time unit before small)

items.zh: 你几点上课？我八点上课。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn shàng kè? Wǒ bā diǎn shàng kè.
items.en: What time do you have class? I have class at 8.

items.zh: 你几点下课？我十一点半下课。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xià kè? Wǒ shíyī diǎn bàn xià kè.
items.en: What time does your class end? My class ends at 11:30.

items.zh: 你几点吃午饭？我十二点吃午饭。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn chī wǔfàn? Wǒ shí'èr diǎn chī wǔfàn.
items.en: What time do you eat lunch? I eat lunch at 12.

items.zh: 你几点吃晚饭？我六点吃晚饭。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn chī wǎnfàn? Wǒ liù diǎn chī wǎnfàn.
items.en: What time do you eat dinner? I eat dinner at 6.

items.zh: 你几点起床？我七点起床。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng? Wǒ qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
items.en: What time do you get up? I get up at 7.

items.zh: 你几点睡觉？我十点半睡觉。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn shuì jiào? Wǒ shí diǎn bàn shuì jiào.
items.en: What time do you go to bed? I go to bed at 10:30.

items.zh: 你几点去图书馆？我下午两点去图书馆。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù túshūguǎn? Wǒ xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
items.en: What time do you go to the library? I go at 2pm.

items.zh: 你几点回宿舍？我晚上九点回宿舍。
items.py: Nǐ jǐ diǎn huí sùshè? Wǒ wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn huí sùshè.
items.en: What time do you go back to the dorm? I go back at 9pm.

items.zh: 现在几点？现在十点二十分。
items.py: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshí fēn.
items.en: What time is it? It's 10:20.

items.zh: 你上午做什么？我上午上课。
items.py: Nǐ shàngwǔ zuò shénme? Wǒ shàngwǔ shàng kè.
items.en: What do you do in the morning? I have class in the morning.

items.zh: 你中午做什么？我中午吃午饭，休息。
items.py: Nǐ zhōngwǔ zuò shénme? Wǒ zhōngwǔ chī wǔfàn, xiūxi.
items.en: What do you do at noon? I eat lunch and rest at noon.

items.zh: 他每天六点半起床，七点吃早饭。
items.py: Tā měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng, qī diǎn chī zǎofàn.
items.en: He gets up at 6:30 and eats breakfast at 7 every day.

items.zh: 下午你去哪儿？我去图书馆。
items.py: Xiàwǔ nǐ qù nǎr? Wǒ qù túshūguǎn.
items.en: Where do you go in the afternoon? I go to the library.

items.zh: 晚上你做什么？我看书，十一点睡觉。
items.py: Wǎnshang nǐ zuò shénme? Wǒ kàn shū, shíyī diǎn shuì jiào.
items.en: What do you do in the evening? I read, and go to bed at 11.

items.zh: 她上午八点上课，十二点下课。
items.py: Tā shàngwǔ bā diǎn shàng kè, shí'èr diǎn xià kè.
items.en: She has class at 8am and finishes at 12.

items.zh: 我们每天下午三点去商店。
items.py: Wǒmen měi tiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn qù shāngdiàn.
items.en: We go to the shop at 3pm every day.
